consequence.statement: New optional capability to drop labels in lambda-promtail; nothing changes for operators who do nothing.

assertion.statement: Lambda-Promtail gains support for dropping labels passed via an environment variable (the variable name is not stated).

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the env var name is not stated in the evidence; only 'an env var' for dropping labels is mentioned; applicability: the subject env var is not named, so no exposure condition can be stated; a new optional feature
